channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Fuel prices dominate midterms, but rising utility bills may be decisive
item.description: Utility bills have risen 40% on average in recent years, with further increases expected.

item.title: Japanese craftsmanship offers lessons on quality and patience as AI makes speed cheap
item.description: AI makes producing more easier. The Japanese shokunin craft tradition provides a guide to making something better.

item.title: UAE golden visa extends to nurses, teachers, and e-sports pros, not just wealthy buyers
item.description: The Gulf state's golden visa combines tax appeal, investment incentives, and talent policy in a country where most residents are foreigners.

item.title: 10 million Americans use advance loan apps for paychecks, costing hundreds more, report finds
item.description: Over 95% of payday loans via direct-to-consumer apps included fees or voluntary tips, and these extra charges are accumulating.
